name: Kurukshetra University Online

about.text: Established in 1956 by our former president of India, the late Dr. Rajendra Prasad, Kurukshetra University started with just one department for Sanskrit, and today it is offering various courses and study programs like MCom, BCom, MA, BA, and many more in online mode. The university is situated in Haryana State. This university is accredited by many government organizations, like NAAC A+ grade, the National Institutional Ranking Framework, and the Internal Quality Assurance Cell. This university campus is located at a place that is famous in the Mahabharata epic, Kurukshetra, around the holy river Brahmi Sarovar, and it is extended in the area of 400 acres of land.

The university campus is well-equipped with all the facilities, from basic to world-class. The campus has an air-conditioned auditorium that has a capacity of 2500 people and has a 70 mm projector, a conference hall, a senate hall, a tennis court, a swimming pool, a basketball court, volleyball courts, and many other courts for various fields. The university encourages students to work in the direction of skill enhancement.

about.text: There are many societies & clubs that students can join. With the capacity of 45 teaching departments, 369 affiliated colleges are situated in the districts of Panipat, Ambala, Yamuna Nagar, Kaithal, Jind, Hisar, Karnal, Panchkula, and Kurukshetra. For the past 65 years, the university has been excelling in offering quality education, and today it is positioned as 8th among the state universities and has been recognized as a Category-1 University.

Most of the study programs that are offered at the University follow CBCS (Choice Based Credit System) along with LOCF (Learning Outcome Curriculum Framework). The university is catering to students with good learning resources like study guides, practice tests, virtual lab environments, and e-books as well. That helps students in getting relevant information useful to understand the syllabus and the curriculum of the examination.

aboutBoxes.title: Online Degree Acceptance
aboutBoxes.content: Online degrees earned from a government-approved university, just like a regular degree, are accepted by the top recruiters worldwide including government & private sectors.

aboutBoxes.title: Value of Online Degree
aboutBoxes.content: An online degree from a government-approved university holds similar recognition in the industry as that of a regular degree. Thus, it is equally valuable when considered for a job or higher education.

aboutBoxes.title: Quality of Education
aboutBoxes.content: The quality of education offered in online programs is of the same standard as offered in an on-campus program. Be it curriculum, faculty members, evaluation methods, practical sessions, online & on-campus programs follow similar standards of quality.

facts: Kurukshetra University came into existence in 1956 by the former president of India, Dr. Rajendra Prasad at the famous place in Mahabharata Epic Kurukshetra.
University is offering various courses and study programs in online mode like MCom, BCom, MA, BA, and many more.
This Institution is accredited by many government organizations like UGC, AICTE, NAAC A+ grade, National Institutional Ranking Framework, and Internal Quality Assurance Cell.
Courses offered at this institution follow CBCS(Choice Based Credit System) & LOCF (Learning Outcome Curriculum Framework).
University has affiliated colleges that are situated in the Districts of Panipat, Ambala, Yamuna Nagar, Kaithal, Jind, Hisar, Karnal, Panchkula, and, Kurukshetra.
It is ranked 8th among all the state universities in Category 1, by the Ministry of Human Resource Development(MHRD).

emi.text: The institution provides courses in all three modes: regular mode, online mode, or distance mode. However, the courses that are offered to the students in regular mode are costly. Online courses offered by the university to the students are much more affordable as compared to other courses offered in regular mode. Students can also take education loans, scholarships, and other financial aid options that are offered to students by the center and state government.

admission.text: You can take admission through an online application process after the university releases the notification on the official website. The admission process is simple, but it is necessary to fill out the online application form carefully. You can follow these steps and get admission to this institute.

Step 1- Wait till the notification is released on the website. Once the university releases it, read it carefully. You can select the course that is available on the website. Also, check the eligibility criteria for pursuing the course.
Step 2 - After carefully looking at the eligibility criteria, move to the next step of filling out the online form. Make a new registration on the admission portal.
Step 3 - The next step is filling out the online form by completing the details. Check all the details twice before the final submission.
Step 4 - Then move to upload the relevant documents. Firstly, scan the documents and then upload them. Make sure to upload clear documents to avoid any future problems.
Step 5 - Once you are done with these steps, a payment portal will appear. Now, move to the final step, which is the submission of the fee. You need to do the fee submission on the payment portal.
Step 6 - The moment you submit the fee, the university will verify your details and send you the admission confirmation through the mail.

examination.text: The examination pattern of each subject may vary. Students can understand more about the pattern after carefully reviewing last year's papers. The examination is done in two steps. The first step includes the evaluation of the practical knowledge of the student. The university gives the assessment to students in the form of practical tests, assignments, project work, and many more. After completion, students can submit these assessments on the portal in online mode. It is not required to visit the center to submit assignments. The next step of evaluation involves the theory examination that is conducted online.

Examination Pattern: Combination of internal assessment (assignments, quizzes) + Term-End Examinations (theory). Re-appear exam Rs. 500 per subject. Exam pattern was updated recently - includes MCQ + Subjective components.
